description: This file defines a command provider for Mattermost's load testing commands, including setup, user, channel, DM, post, threaded post, URL, and JSON commands. It registers the command, handles command execution, and includes functions for creating test environments and posts.

classes.name: LoadTestProvider
classes.description: Implements a command provider for Mattermost load testing commands, registering and handling various test-related commands.

methods.name: GetTrigger
methods.description: Returns the trigger string for the command provider, which is 'test'.

methods.name: GetCommand
methods.description: Returns the command configuration if testing is enabled, otherwise nil.

methods.name: DoCommand
methods.description: Executes the appropriate load test command based on the message prefix.

methods.name: doCommand
methods.description: Handles specific subcommands like setup, users, channels, dms, posts, post, threaded_post, url, json, and help.

methods.name: HelpCommand
methods.description: Returns the help message with usage instructions.

methods.name: SetupCommand
methods.description: Creates a test environment with specified number of teams, channels, users, and posts, optionally fuzzed.

methods.name: ActivateUserCommand
methods.description: Activates a user by user ID.

methods.name: DeActivateUserCommand
methods.description: Deactivates a user by user ID.

methods.name: UsersCommand
methods.description: Adds a number of test users with optional fuzz and time parameters.

methods.name: ChannelsCommand
methods.description: Creates test channels with optional fuzz, range, type, and time parameters.

methods.name: DmsCommand
methods.description: Creates direct message conversations with test users.

methods.name: ThreadedPostCommand
methods.description: Creates threaded posts with nested replies.

methods.name: PostsCommand
methods.description: Creates multiple posts with optional fuzz, range, images, and time parameters.

methods.name: PostCommand
methods.description: Creates a single post in a specified channel as another user.

methods.name: URLCommand
methods.description: Posts content from a URL into the current channel.

methods.name: JSONCommand
methods.description: Posts content from a JSON payload URL into the current channel.

methods.name: getMatch
methods.description: Extracts a matched group from a regex pattern applied to text.

methods.name: parseRange
methods.description: Parses a range string into a utils.Range object.
